title: Reinstatement Extension Months for Patients with an Assistance Award
content:
Financial-assistance coordination standard — **Patient Payment Plans**: reinstatement extension months for a patient holding an approved award under the Patient Financial Assistance Program.

## The rule

A patient with an approved financial-assistance award adds 3 reinstatement extension months when 2 or more installments were recorded missed less than 3 whole months before today and 2 months otherwise; any other patient adds none.

The extension months are added to the installments the reinstated balance is spread over.

## Reading the records

- **Approved award** — a case of the patient under the Patient Financial Assistance Program whose status is approved. The award's percentage does not matter here.
- **Installments recorded missed less than 3 whole months before today** — missed-installment lines on the plan ledger dated within that span.

| Approved award | Missed-installment lines in the last 3 whole months | Reinstatement extension months |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 2 or more | 3 |
| Yes | 0 or 1 | 2 |
| No | any | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases

- Approved 25 percent award; missed-installment lines dated 1 and 2 months ago: 3 months are added.
- Approved full-discount award; one missed-installment line in the span (the other dated 5 months ago): 2 months are added.
- Application denied; three missed-installment lines in the span: none.
- Example of the effect: a reinstated balance spread over 6 installments is, with 3 extension months, spread over 9.
